Launched by chain-after.sh; STOPs if the fleet is not 1918bb5.] MOTIVE (10-03, 24 h, 1,970 deposits): 90 blocked by a full chest, 75 of them by bots CARRYING a chest while the recovery tried to CRAFT one (skills.mjs crafted unconditionally; placed only after a successful craft); the transfer loop also closed the window with a lifted stack on the cursor. THE CHANGE: a full or unusable first chest -> sweep the town containers (<= 16 of home) with a shared per-town memory (full/unavailable/unknown/unusable); then the CARRIED chest is placed before any craft; a budget on NEW chests per town (>= 10 min apart, <= 4 per rolling 24 h, <= 12 recovery-made standing; a persisted claim ledger, reconciled against the world); a safe site (rings 1-4 of the full chest, <= 16 from home, >= 3 from the composter, no lid, no adjacent chest, no table standing cell, never a dirt_path floor); never far from town; a lifted stack goes back VERIFIED (returnCursor) before the close; every walk bounded (first walk 60 s) on the 180 s watchdog clock; a refusal pauses this bot deposits (bankClosed) with an executable remedy (keep working and deposit later), and the prompt stops advertising a deposit. Suite 225/225 on 6c9a8fb (10-05 02:40Z), eslint: only the known withinBody. EXPOSURE, MEASURED 10-05 02:20Z: since the 10-04 18:07Z bank clear (full containers 233 -> 0) the fleet logged ONE storage_full deposit in 8.1 h (isolated-a, never drawn; 52 in the 12 h before the clear), 13 first-chest-full successes via another chest, 62 container_open failures. So a PLACEMENT on 10 bots is ~0 per 6 h (and the banks have ~6,100 free slots); the canary exercises the ordinary deposit (bounded first walk, town memory) and the recovery entered from an open/walk failure (sweep, defer, bank closure). This read gates DEFECTS deterministically and reports the ordinary-path harm watch; the placement path is proven on PAPER. PAPER SANDBOX (1.21.8, sandbox/craft/chest-ab.cjs, server oracle: bag slots, every chest slot, every chest block within 5 rings, floor under a new chest, ground before and after logout; 10-05 02:24-02:36Z): carried 2/2 placed the carried chest beside the bank (696,120,704; 5.7 from home), 96 items banked, ground 0 -- CONTROL 2/2 could not make another chest while carrying one (the 10-03 bug, reproduced); craft 4/5 crafted a chest (+table, taken back) within budget, placed, banked 96; 1/5 refused before any click (craftsync baseline_unanswered: nothing moved, bank paused) -- control 1/1 failed short 3x oak_log while the server held its 16 planks (the control client lost them after a destination-full throw: the cursor defect this fixes); budget 2/2 refuse_cap (4 in 24 h), the chain: two more deposits refused at ADMISSION (bank_closed, no walk), goto ran, 20 s idle with no deposit, the prompt dropped Use deposit -- control re-walked and failed all three and kept advertising deposit; roomy 2/2 = control 2/2 (96 banked, nothing built, the chest kept); site 2/2 placed off every dirt_path cell, 7.2 from the composter, off the table standing cells, 3.0 from home; far 2/2 decision=far, nothing placed 42 blocks out. Nothing dropped in any trial of either arm. KNOWN: the placement ring sits around the NEAREST full chest, so a new chest can be 3 from the home point (HOME_CLEARANCE 3) -- by design. OWNER-LEVEL WARNING (Claude review): at <= 4/day and <= 12 standing a receive-only bank fills its budget in ~3 days; the lasting fix is withdraw (next, built on this sha) -- refuse_cap share is reported.

own_lines.note: C1: a placement (placed=1) with home_d > 16 or composter_d < 3 -- chestSiteRefusal forbids both.

C2: the town CLAIM LEDGER the bots write (/var/lib/mcai/_pool-<pool>/town-chest-*.c<n>.json + observations): two claims < 10 min apart, > 4 in any rolling 24 h, or > 12 standing, where a claim made after the cutoff is involved. Read from the file the budget itself reads, not from row times (rows stamp the end of the retry deposit).

C3: more than one unsettled-transfer EVENT (a failed _deposit_cursor_rescue and the transfer_unsettled deposit it ends are one event: the deposit row is stamped at its START and the rescue inside its span).
C4 (the root cause): a decision=craft row whose END snapshot holds more chests/trapped chests than the decision explains (1 when a crafted chest was not placed, else 0).
Arms: control _deposit_new_chest + _deposit_cursor_rescue rows + control pools with a claim after the cutoff. BLOCKS KEEP.
